I will think about this year same as every year. Two mu is not much land, but it feeds us and I do not waste it.

For my wheat, I planted it last October like always. The seeds I bought from the shop in town — the man there gave me the same kind my neighbor Wang uses, she gets good wheat every year so I trust it. Not the old village seed, the new kind, everybody uses it now. I put down two bags of the compound fertilizer (复合肥) before planting, that is about 50 jin each bag, so 100 jin for my two mu. That is what my husband and I always do. In spring when the wheat wakes up I will put urea (尿素), maybe one bag — 50 jin spread over two mu. I water from the well three times: once after planting if no rain, once in spring when it turns green (返青水), and once when the grain is filling. If bugs come or the leaves get rusty I spray — usually two times, my son buys the medicine from the shop. Wheat gives me maybe 800 jin per mu if the year is good, 400 kg.

For maize after wheat, I do not plow — no time, the wheat is cut and the maize must go in right away. The big machine rolls through and I plant with the seeder. Hybrid seed, the dealer tells me which one, Zhengdan or Xianyu, whatever he has. For maize I put one bag of compound at planting and then urea at the big-leaf stage (大喇叭口), about 40-50 jin of urea. Maize here does not need much water if the rain comes — I water one time, maybe two if July is dry. Spray once for the borer worm. Maize gives 1000-1200 jin per mu, about 550 kg.

I do not want to spend more on fertilizer than I need, but I would rather put a little extra than have thin wheat. My seven people at home, some work outside and send money, so for these two mu I keep it simple like always.
